correctness.rationale: Exact A^8=I+3B and eight-branch unit-difference table give six bijective regular coset branches and least period 8·3^(k−1). Pell norm Q_n²−2P_n²=(−1)^n gives two exceptional 3-adic branches in each sequence, transformed by explicit isometries to unit-scaled squares modulo 3^(k−2). Exact counts of square roots of each 3-adic valuation yield all reported frequencies. Reproducible exact-integer full-period computation passed both sequences for every k from 1 to 11 (1,417,168 terms). Finite checks do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: Exact infinite classification of an intrinsic natural sequence statistic: distribution of the number of visits to each residue in a fundamental period. It strictly strengthens known residue completeness and reveals two quadratic 3-adic critical branches producing unexpectedly identical yet nonuniform frequency histograms for distinct sequences. The result is not a support computation or a bounded table.
